# ta

Technical analysis functions. Each takes and returns series and is declared once at the top level; the runtime advances it on every bar.

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`ta.sma()`](#ta-sma) | Simple moving average: the mean of the last `length` values. |
| [`ta.ema()`](#ta-ema) | Exponential moving average with alpha 2 / (length + 1), seeded with the SMA of the first `length` values. |
| [`ta.rma()`](#ta-rma) | Wilder's moving average (RMA, used by RSI and ATR): alpha 1 / length, seeded with the SMA of the first `length` values. |
| [`ta.wma()`](#ta-wma) | Weighted moving average: the newest value weighs `length`, the oldest 1. |
| [`ta.vwma()`](#ta-vwma) | Volume-weighted moving average over the last `length` bars, weighted by candle volume (alpha). |
| [`ta.rsi()`](#ta-rsi) | Relative Strength Index, 0..100, from Wilder-smoothed gains and losses of `src`. |
| [`ta.macd()`](#ta-macd) | MACD: `macd` = EMA(fast) − EMA(slow), `signal` = EMA(macd, signal), `hist` = macd − signal. |
| [`ta.bbands()`](#ta-bbands) | Bollinger Bands: `middle` = SMA(length), `upper`/`lower` = middle ± mult × standard deviation. |
| [`ta.atr()`](#ta-atr) | Average True Range: the RMA of `ta.tr()` over `length` bars. |
| [`ta.tr()`](#ta-tr) | True range: the largest of high − low, \|high − previous close\| and \|low − previous close\|. |
| [`ta.stdev()`](#ta-stdev) | Standard deviation of the last `length` values (population form, dividing by `length`). |
| [`ta.variance()`](#ta-variance) | Variance of the last `length` values: the square of `ta.stdev()`. |
| [`ta.highest()`](#ta-highest) | Highest value of the last `length` values. |
| [`ta.lowest()`](#ta-lowest) | Lowest value of the last `length` values. |
| [`ta.change()`](#ta-change) | Difference between the current value and the value `length` steps ago (default 1). |
| [`ta.roc()`](#ta-roc) | Rate of change in percent: 100 × (value − value `length` ago) / value `length` ago. |
| [`ta.mom()`](#ta-mom) | Momentum: the current value minus the value `length` steps ago (the same as `ta.change()`). |
| [`ta.crossover()`](#ta-crossover) | 1 on the bar where `a` crosses above `b` (a &gt; b now, a &lt;= b one step ago), else 0. |
| [`ta.crossunder()`](#ta-crossunder) | 1 on the bar where `a` crosses below `b` (a &lt; b now, a &gt;= b one step ago), else 0. |
| [`ta.cross()`](#ta-cross) | 1 on the bar where `a` crosses `b` in either direction, else 0. |
| [`ta.rising()`](#ta-rising) | 1 when `src` rose on each of the last `length` steps, else 0. |
| [`ta.falling()`](#ta-falling) | 1 when `src` fell on each of the last `length` steps, else 0. |
| [`ta.barssince()`](#ta-barssince) | Steps since `cond` was last 1 (0 on the step it is 1). |
| [`ta.valuewhen()`](#ta-valuewhen) | Value of `src` when `cond` was 1, `occurrence` times back (0 = the latest; at most 3). |
| [`ta.cum()`](#ta-cum) | Running total of `src` since the first bar; NaN values are skipped. |
| [`ta.sum()`](#ta-sum) | Sum of the last `length` values. |
| [`ta.vwap()`](#ta-vwap) | Volume-weighted average price of the typical price (hlc3), restarting at 00:00 UTC every day. |
| [`ta.supertrend()`](#ta-supertrend) | TradingView definition. |
| [`ta.adx()`](#ta-adx) | Average Directional Index (trend strength, 0..100) from directional movement over `diLength`, smoothed over `adxSmoothing`. |
| [`ta.stoch()`](#ta-stoch) | Stochastic oscillator: `k` = SMA(kSmooth) of the close's position in the `kLength`-bar range (0..100), `d` = SMA(dSmooth) of `k`. |
| [`ta.obv()`](#ta-obv) | On-balance volume: a running total that adds the bar's volume when the close rises and subtracts it when it falls. |
| [`ta.pivothigh()`](#ta-pivothigh) | The high `right` bars ago when it is strictly above the `left` highs before it and the `right` highs after it, else NaN. |
| [`ta.pivotlow()`](#ta-pivotlow) | The low `right` bars ago when it is strictly below the `left` lows before it and the `right` lows after it, else NaN. |
| [`ta.na()`](#ta-na) | 1 where `src` is NaN (no value yet), else 0. |
| [`ta.nz()`](#ta-nz) | `src` with NaN replaced by `replacement` (default 0). |
| [`ta.calc()`](#ta-calc) | Derived series from the current values of its inputs, e.g. |
| [`ta.dev()`](#ta-dev) | Mean absolute deviation from the SMA (TradingView ta.dev). |
| [`ta.cci()`](#ta-cci) | Commodity Channel Index (TradingView ta.cci). |
| [`ta.mfi()`](#ta-mfi) | Money Flow Index over `src` (usually hlc3) and candle volume (TradingView ta.mfi). |
| [`ta.wpr()`](#ta-wpr) | Williams %R (TradingView ta.wpr), -100..0. |

## Moving averages

### ta.sma() {#ta-sma}

```ts
ta.sma(src: Series, length: number): Series
```

Simple moving average: the mean of the last `length` values. NaN until `length` values exist.

Types: [Series](./series#series)

### ta.ema() {#ta-ema}

```ts
ta.ema(src: Series, length: number): Series
```

Exponential moving average with alpha 2 / (length + 1), seeded with the SMA of the first `length` values.

Types: [Series](./series#series)

### ta.rma() {#ta-rma}

```ts
ta.rma(src: Series, length: number): Series
```

Wilder's moving average (RMA, used by RSI and ATR): alpha 1 / length, seeded with the SMA of the first `length` values.

Types: [Series](./series#series)

### ta.wma() {#ta-wma}

```ts
ta.wma(src: Series, length: number): Series
```

Weighted moving average: the newest value weighs `length`, the oldest 1.

Types: [Series](./series#series)

### ta.vwma() {#ta-vwma}

```ts
ta.vwma(src: Series, length: number): Series
```

Volume-weighted moving average over the last `length` bars, weighted by candle volume (alpha).

Types: [Series](./series#series)

### ta.vwap() {#ta-vwap}

```ts
ta.vwap(): Series
```

Volume-weighted average price of the typical price (hlc3), restarting at 00:00 UTC every day.

Types: [Series](./series#series)

```ts

ta.tr(): Series
```

```ts
ta.stdev(src: Series, length: number): Series
```

```ts
ta.variance(src: Series, length: number): Series
```

## Volume

### ta.obv() {#ta-obv}

```ts
ta.obv(): Series
```

On-balance volume: a running total that adds the bar's volume when the close rises and subtracts it when it falls.

Types: [Series](./series#series)

## Ranges and pivots

### ta.highest() {#ta-highest}

```ts
ta.highest(src: Series, length: number): Series
```

Highest value of the last `length` values. NaN if any of them is NaN.

Types: [Series](./series#series)

### ta.lowest() {#ta-lowest}

```ts
ta.lowest(src: Series, length: number): Series
```

Lowest value of the last `length` values. NaN if any of them is NaN.

Types: [Series](./series#series)

### ta.pivothigh() {#ta-pivothigh}

```ts
ta.pivothigh(left: number, right: number): Series
```

The high `right` bars ago when it is strictly above the `left` highs before it and the `right` highs after it, else NaN. Confirmed `right` bars late.

Types: [Series](./series#series)

### ta.pivotlow() {#ta-pivotlow}

```ts
ta.pivotlow(left: number, right: number): Series
```

The low `right` bars ago when it is strictly below the `left` lows before it and the `right` lows after it, else NaN. Confirmed `right` bars late.

Types: [Series](./series#series)

## Conditions

### ta.crossover() {#ta-crossover}

```ts
ta.crossover(a: SeriesLike, b: SeriesLike): BoolSeries
```

1 on the bar where `a` crosses above `b` (a &gt; b now, a &lt;= b one step ago), else 0.

Types: [SeriesLike](./series#serieslike), [BoolSeries](./series#boolseries)

### ta.crossunder() {#ta-crossunder}

```ts
ta.crossunder(a: SeriesLike, b: SeriesLike): BoolSeries
```

1 on the bar where `a` crosses below `b` (a &lt; b now, a &gt;= b one step ago), else 0.

Types: [SeriesLike](./series#serieslike), [BoolSeries](./series#boolseries)

### ta.cross() {#ta-cross}

```ts
ta.cross(a: SeriesLike, b: SeriesLike): BoolSeries
```

1 on the bar where `a` crosses `b` in either direction, else 0.

Types: [SeriesLike](./series#serieslike), [BoolSeries](./series#boolseries)

### ta.rising() {#ta-rising}

```ts
ta.rising(src: Series, length: number): BoolSeries
```

1 when `src` rose on each of the last `length` steps, else 0.

Types: [Series](./series#series), [BoolSeries](./series#boolseries)

### ta.falling() {#ta-falling}

```ts
ta.falling(src: Series, length: number): BoolSeries
```

1 when `src` fell on each of the last `length` steps, else 0.

Types: [Series](./series#series), [BoolSeries](./series#boolseries)

### ta.barssince() {#ta-barssince}

```ts
ta.barssince(cond: BoolSeries): Series
```

Steps since `cond` was last 1 (0 on the step it is 1). NaN until it has been 1 once.

Types: [BoolSeries](./series#boolseries), [Series](./series#series)

### ta.valuewhen() {#ta-valuewhen}

```ts
ta.valuewhen(cond: BoolSeries, src: Series, occurrence: number): Series
```

Value of `src` when `cond` was 1, `occurrence` times back (0 = the latest; at most 3).

Types: [BoolSeries](./series#boolseries), [Series](./series#series)

### ta.na() {#ta-na}


Types: [Series](./series#series), [BoolSeries](./series#boolseries)

### ta.nz() {#ta-nz}

```ts
ta.nz(src: Series, replacement?: number): Series
```

`src` with NaN replaced by `replacement` (default 0).

Types: [Series](./series#series)

### ta.calc() {#ta-calc}

```ts
ta.calc(inputs: readonly Series[], fn: (...values: number[]) => number): Series
```

Derived series from the current values of its inputs, e.g. `ta.calc([basis, atr], (b, a) => b + 2 * a)`. The function must be pure; it runs once per bar (or block) and again on every update of the open bar. NaN in = NaN out unless you handle it.

Types: [Series](./series#series)
